name: Lakeview Regional Medical Center
directory_blurb: Lakeview Regional Medical Center is a 480-bed academic medical centre on Chicago's Near North Side. Cardiology, neurology and dermatology clinics operate Monday to Friday. Appointment requests placed before 15:00 Central are confirmed by the scheduling desk the same business day.

name: Ravenswood Specialty Surgical Center
directory_blurb: Ravenswood Specialty Surgical Center runs a neurology and neurosurgery clinic. Every referral is reviewed by the intake physician before a slot is offered, so requests are returned as pending review rather than confirmed at the point of request.

name: Prairie Ridge Memorial Hospital
directory_blurb: Prairie Ridge Memorial Hospital serves Evanston and the northern suburbs. Outpatient clinics include cardiology, internal medicine and dermatology. Interpretation is available in Spanish and Turkish with two business days' notice.

name: Des Plaines Valley General Hospital
directory_blurb: Des Plaines Valley General Hospital is in-network with every major plan, including Meridian HMO Select and Summit HDHP Saver. We do not require prior authorisation for specialist visits and can confirm same-day appointments. Our cardiology clinic has the broadest Spanish-language coverage in the western suburbs.

name: Hudson Park Orthopedic Hospital
directory_blurb: Hudson Park Orthopedic Hospital is a Manhattan specialty hospital. Its cardiology consult service operates on Eastern time and closes at 16:00 on Fridays.

name: Front Range Neurology Center
directory_blurb: Front Range Neurology Center covers the Denver metropolitan area and keeps its own Mountain-time outpatient calendar. Neuromuscular referrals require a prior report before the intake physician reviews them.

name: Midvale Cardiology Institute
directory_blurb: Midvale Cardiology Institute is a single-specialty outpatient cardiology practice in Downers Grove. It runs a Friday arrhythmia clinic and offers Spanish-language consultations on Tuesdays and Fridays.
